# manta_rfe (Resource)

Manage redfish endpoint.
It interacts with the State Management Database (SMD)

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "manta_rfe" "rfe" {
  id                 = rfe.xname
  user               = "root"
  hostname           = rfe.hostname
  rediscoveronupdate = true
  enabled            = true
  password_wo        = rfe.password
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) RFE's xname

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `domain` (String) domain of redfish endpoint's FQDN
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `fqdn` (String)
- `hostname` (String) hostname of redfish endpoint's FQDN
- `password_wo` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) password to use when interrogating endpoint
- `rediscoveronupdate` (Boolean)
- `user` (String) username to use when interrogating endpoint

### Read-Only

- `last_updated` (String)
- `type` (String)
